title: Telemetry muxer versioning and client feature-gating for SDK/CLI/API
creator: Ava Rios
description:
Problem: As we expand telemetry producers (hosted SDKs, CLI, agents and private control-planes) we risk event contract drift and subtle analytic gaps when clients are on differing agent/SDK versions. Current approach relies on server-side leniency and ad-hoc ingestion shims; that increases maintenance and hides bad producer behavior.

Goal: Implement a telemetry 'muxer' and versioning strategy that: (1) enables explicit client-server capability negotiation, (2) allows gradual server-side adapters per-version, (3) supports feature-gates on new event fields to reduce telemetry noise, and (4) provides a validation + canary rollout path for schema changes across SDK/CLI/API.

Scope: console backend services and ingestion pipeline surface only (not UI work). Deliverables are: protocol spec for the negotiation header, server-side muxer component (logical router that routes events to versioned transformers), a lightweight SDK/CLI handshake implementation, a migration playbook for data consumers to adapt, and observable SLOs/alerts for schema regressions.

Design decisions so far: 1) Use a single HTTP header X-Telemetry-Prot with semver-ish token (ex: 2.1.0+features=ctx-kv) for capability signaling; 2) Keep canonical server schema as v_latest and implement per-version transform layers that map older client shapes into canonical; 3) Add a feature-gate registry in the muxer so we can toggle acceptance of experimental fields per-customer or per-environment; 4) Emit transformation metadata (transform.applied, transform.orig_version) as meta-attributes for downstream debugging and replay.

Backwards compatibility plan: default to best-effort accept of unknown fields but tag events as 'unvalidated' until the adapter is written. Critical downstream consumers must opt into strict mode via ingestion config; otherwise we keep preserving unknown fields in a non-indexed blob to avoid data loss.

Rollout & validation: Implement unit + contract tests and a harness that runs SDK/CLI sampled telemetry across the adapter matrix. Start with internal SDK canary (10% of traffic) -> telemetry-muxer canary in staging -> 1% production -> 25% -> global. If transformation error rate > 0.5% or schema-alerts fire, automatic rollback to pass-through mode.

Observability: New dashboards: per-version event volume, transformation error rate, latency p95 for ingress, 'unvalidated' event ratio, and downstream consumer rejections. Create an alert when a newly released client version generates >5% malformed events in 6 hours.

Operational notes: The muxer will be implemented as a stateless microservice in front of the existing ingestion pipeline so we can scale independently. Persistent adapter code is stored in the telemetry-transform repo and versioned per-release. We will ship a migration guide and a small SDK helper to format the X-Telemetry-Prot header.

Out-of-scope: long-term storage schema changes for warehouse consumers (to be handled by analytics team migrations) and any UI feature gating for Console (handled by PM).
